candidates.change_summary: Delete the require statement so that depositsCount is no longer checked against overflow before incrementing.
Delete the increment statement so that depositsCount is no longer updated on deposits.
Replace the increment with a decrement so each deposit reduces depositsCount instead of increasing it.
Remove the call to withdraw(address(this).balance) so withdrawAll no longer transfers any Ether to the owner.
Replace the withdrawal amount with 0 so withdrawAll transfers zero Wei instead of the full contract balance.
Replace the withdrawal amount with 1 Wei so withdrawAll transfers 1 Wei instead of the full contract balance.
Remove the require(msg.sender == owner) check from the onlyOwner modifier so any caller can execute withdrawAll and drain the contract.
Invert the ownership check to require(msg.sender != owner) so the owner is blocked and any non-owner can call withdrawAll.
